summary: Steel live-in lookout near the Continental Divide in Yellowstone, one of about five manned lookouts; dismantled in 1991, nothing remains at the site.

facts.status_note: Dismantled in 1991. The register says nothing remains at the site.

access.note: Reached on foot by the Divide Trail from the Old Faithful to West Thumb road. No closure appears in these sources.

visit.trail_note: The trail starts at a pullout on the Old Faithful to West Thumb road, just west of Craig Pass, and climbs about 710 feet through the forest to the site.

events.note: Dismantled in 1991; the register lists removal that year
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register on January 2, 2026

notes_for_editor: No source read gives the build year, and no staffing dates were found, so neither is in the story or facts. The Yellowstone manned-lookout claim is from a 2018 quote by a Mount Washburn lookout, not a dated record. Elevation: FFLOS gives 8,771 ft (2,673 m) and firelookout.com gives 8750'; the record keeps the FFLOS figure. The FFLOS list marks it as removed in 1991, and the firelookout.org list marks it Tower Gone. The Facebook post about Divide could not be read, so it is not cited. The firelookout.com page has a photo credited to NPS Archives, but no image URL was retrieved, so no photo is listed.
